text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (...I failed to grasp victory, and the race left me with nothing but homework to do. However—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (I will definitely make use of this next time. And next time, I will produce "results.")

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Onto the next.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S was so close.
Still... she's truly the same as always, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "Doesn't she feel any frustration? It's kind of hard to tell with her."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Even if my knees get stained with dirt,
...even if I'm never granted a rematch."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san... never changes.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fixing my gaze on what lies ahead...
Simply to do what must be done...
With an unchanging, indomitable heart, I rise...—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to become one too.
An unshakeable "hero" just like you!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Good grief, what a fickle thing fate is.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ......Gimlet――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we both poured out every ounce of our soul's surge.
This, too, is a turning point for us—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh hehâ
Those eyes, that running, capable of freezing even frenzy solid...
I have burned them firmly into my memory.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "fateful day" came to an end—
and our paths were meant to diverge.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: (What is this...? For some reason, Gimlet's words aren't getting through to me like usual—)

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet!! That was so close!
Prove you're the strongest next time!!

text_block_list.name: Gimlet Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You were amaziiing!!
I'll never forget that runnn!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh—
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Gim-senpai...!
You were so close... You must be so frustrated, yet you still look so cool—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Me too... Even I...!
Just like Gim-senpai...!!
I'm definitely gonna become a super cool Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Bwaaa-hahaha! Go mad with bliss!
Bask in the dazzling brilliance of mine, burned into your very eyes!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet!! Lord Gim!!
That was so close!! You're the strongest!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(That is... the frenzy Gimlet brought forth.
Gimlet's run has burned itself into their minds—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...Creating such feverish excitement
is surely something I cannot do—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(A sight completely unlike anything of mine...
one that only Gimlet could ever create—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Now then.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And with this, my curtain falls.
The seeds of the next chaos have been sown, and what arrives is a delightful boredom—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I've done enough.
—What comes 'after' is your era, Kris S."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Wait. What... does that mean?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
You'll understand in time.

Symboli Kris S returned after finishing the fierce battle.
Her demeanor, as always,
remained entirely calm.

However, seeing her remain unchanged like that,
I find myself feeling relieved—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...Forgive me.
I failed... to live up to your trust—
choice_data_list: No, it's a "result" we can learn from for next time.
No, it's a "result" we can build on for next time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I will definitely make use of this.
For the next 'result'—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That's why...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I'll be counting on you from now on as well.
"Just straight ahead. Toward the next 'result.' With an unwavering pace, I resolved to start anew from here...!"
That night—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Autumn, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
Falling leaves beneath a setting sun. Truly fitting for the end.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet the world, and time, only moves forward.
Leaving me behind, along with my memories—"

Unheard by anyone,
those words simply dissolved into the starry sky—
